title: [PowerRename] "Aa" and "Aa Aa" text formatting options produce identical results

reproduce.title: Distinguish Title case from Capitalize Each Word
prerequisites: Create a disposable file named `hello and world.txt`.
Uncheck `Use regular expressions` and `Apply to every instance`.
steps: Open PowerRename for the test file.
Select `Aa` (Title case) and record the preview.
Select `Aa Aa` (Capitalize Each Word) and record the preview.
reproduce.expected_result: Title case previews `Hello and World.txt`; Capitalize Each Word previews `Hello And World.txt`.

fix_assessment.rationale: The supplied result is expected for these two modes; a sentence-case transformation would be a feature, not this demonstrated regression.
